psf_cap_vs_market_gap.finding: Nearly every freehold in-band candidate trades BELOW the $2,100 cap: Siglap V ~$1,500, Le Crescendo ~$1,700, Oasis Garden $1,673, Elliot $1,690-1,806, Flamingo $1,910, The Tembusu $1,940, Carpmael $2,045, Bliss penthouses $1,246-1,281. The cap is NOT the binding constraint - the $2.2M quantum ceiling is. To be under cap AND >=1,000 sqft AND <=$2.2M you are forced into a ~1,000-1,076 sqft 3BR or a large-plate 2BR penthouse.
psf_cap_vs_market_gap.exception: Core D15 (Katong/Amber/Tanjong Rhu) freehold trades $2,300-2,830 psf - ABOVE the cap - so there both cap and ceiling bind and the district is effectively out of band. Only Frankel/Bedok/Siglap fringe FH stays under cap in D15.

filter_tradeoff_insight.headline: The tradeoff has shifted from 'D15 vs D19' to 'quantum ceiling vs floor-plate size'.
filter_tradeoff_insight.unit_count: Large FH developments (>150u) that fit the band exist only on the D14/D19 fringe (Le Crescendo 228u, Vacanza 473u, The Tembusu 337u) - and only their ENTRY 3BR stack fits. Large D15 FH estates (Sea View, One Amber) are all above cap. Boutique passes (Carpmael 16u, Fiorenza 28u) have near-zero liquidity - a pass today may vanish with no backup.
filter_tradeoff_insight.psf: Sub-cap PSF is available almost everywhere except core D15, but sub-cap + >=1,000 sqft + <=$2.2M is only jointly satisfiable at ~1,000-1,076 sqft. You cannot have a large freehold floor plate AND sub-cap PSF AND <=$2.2M at once.
filter_tradeoff_insight.region: The buyer's most-preferred area (D15 core Katong/Amber/Tanjong Rhu) is exactly where freehold is priced out. In-band freehold clusters in D14 Paya Lebar (Le Crescendo) and D19 Kovan/Woodleigh (Tembusu, Bliss, Oasis) - the investment-numbers districts. Bartley/Woodleigh/MacPherson specifically is overwhelmingly 99-yr leasehold, so the D19 sub-areas added this week yield little freehold (only The Lilium 2022, Parc Mondrian 2010).
filter_tradeoff_insight.highest_leverage_flex: Raising the quantum ceiling by ~$150k ($2.2M -> ~$2.35M) converts three freehold near-misses - Elliot 1,313 sqft ($2.35M), Oasis Garden 1,216 sqft ($2.28M), Tangerine Grove 1,184 sqft ($2.30M) - into genuine LARGE 3BR passes, two of them in preferred districts. This single flex buys more (and larger) freehold 3BRs than relaxing PSF or tenure would.
